SELECT p.patron_number, p.status, p.category,
              EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loans l WHERE l.patron_number = p.patron_number AND l.status = 'overdue') AS has_overdue_loan
         FROM patrons p WHERE p.patron_number = $1
